The 25th SPUDM conference will be held in Budapest (Hungary) in 2015. The conference will be organized by <a href="http://www.uni-corvinus.hu/index.php?id=23689" target="_blank">Richard Sz</a><a href="http://www.uni-corvinus.hu/index.php?id=23689" target="_blank">anto</a> at the <a href="http://portal.uni-corvinus.hu/?id=44509" target="_blank">Corvinus University</a>.

Details will follow in due time.

We are all looking forward seeing you there!
